export async function listTools() {
  return [{
    name: 'text_transform',
    description: 'Transform text by mode (uppercase, lowercase, or slug).',
    inputSchema: {
      type: 'object',
      additionalProperties: false,
      properties: {
        text: { type: 'string', description: 'Input text to transform.' },
        mode: { type: 'string', enum: ['uppercase', 'lowercase', 'slug'] },
        trim: { type: 'boolean', description: 'Trim whitespace before transform. Defaults to true.' }
      },
      required: ['text', 'mode']
    }
  }];
}

function slugify(input) {
  // Replace runs of non-alphanumeric with hyphen
  const hyphenated = input.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-');
  // Remove edge hyphens
  return hyphenated.replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '');
}

export async function callTool(name, args) {
  if (name !== 'text_transform') {
    throw new Error('Unknown tool');
  }
  
  const { text, mode, trim = true } = args || {};
  
  if (typeof text !== 'string') throw new Error('Invalid input: text must be a string');
  if (typeof mode !== 'string') throw new Error('Invalid input: mode must be a string');
  if (!['uppercase', 'lowercase', 'slug'].includes(mode)) {
    throw new Error('Invalid input: mode must be one of uppercase, lowercase, slug');
  }
  if (trim !== undefined && typeof trim !== 'boolean') {
    throw new Error('Invalid input: trim must be a boolean');
  }
  
  // Reject extra inputs (only if additional keys exist beyond text/mode/trim)
  const knownKeys = new Set(['text', 'mode', 'trim']);
  for (const k of Object.keys(args || {})) {
    if (!knownKeys.has(k)) throw new Error(`Invalid input: unexpected argument '${k}'`);
  }
  
  let value = text;
  if (trim) value = value.trim();
  
  if (mode === 'uppercase') value = value.toUpperCase();
  else if (mode === 'lowercase') value = value.toLowerCase();
  else if (mode === 'slug') value = slugify(value);
  
  return { content: [{ type: 'text', text: value }] };
}
